goal:
Create the file /workspace/tests/Playwright.Tests/pages/CourseBrowsePage.ts

This is a Playwright Page Object for the course browse page. The Razor page at src/Host/Pages/Courses/Index.cshtml has:
- Search input with id="search-input" (HTMX-triggered)
- Category select with name="category" 
- Clear link button with text "Clear" (class="btn btn-ghost")
- Course list container with id="course-list"
- Each course card is a .card div with an h3 containing a link to the course detail

The file should:
- Extend BasePage from '../BasePage'
- Export a CourseBrowsePage class
- Have locators: searchInput (#search-input), categorySelect (select[name="category"]), clearButton (by role link "Clear"), courseList (#course-list), courseCard(courseTitle) dynamic locator
- Have methods: isOnBrowsePage() checking URL, searchFor(query), selectCategory(cat), getCourseTitles() returning visible titles, getCourseCount()
- Import { Page, Locator } from '@playwright/test'
